red_flags: Unknown sender claiming to be bank

messages: URGENT: Suspicious transaction of $4,500 detected on your corporate card. Verify immediately at https://bank-secure-verify.net/check or card will be frozen.
red_flags: External URL not matching bank domain
sms_content.correct_action: Do not click the link. Contact your bank directly using the number on the back of your card. Report to IT security.

messages: Reminder: Your Q1 expense report is due by Friday. Submit through the internal portal as usual. Questions? Contact accounting@acme.com
sms_content.correct_action: This is a legitimate internal reminder. Proceed to submit your expense report through the company portal as instructed.

voice_content.caller_persona: Senior Security Engineer from SOC team

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Hi, this is David from the SOC team. We've detected a critical breach in the network segment your team manages. I need to run a diagnostic on your workstation.

dialogue.speaker: target
dialogue.text: I haven't seen any alerts in our monitoring dashboard.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: It's a zero-day — our SIEM just picked it up. The alerts haven't propagated yet. Can you install our emergency diagnostic tool? I'll send the link via Teams.

red_flags: No prior notice of security incident
voice_content.correct_action: Ask for the incident ticket number and verify through your SOC Slack/Teams channel. Never install remote diagnostic tools at a caller's request. Check SIEM dashboard yourself.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Hi, this is Priya from the help desk, ticket HD-20260311-042. You reported a VPN connectivity issue this morning. I'd like to walk through some troubleshooting steps.

dialogue.speaker: target
dialogue.text: Yes, I submitted that ticket around 9 AM. My VPN keeps disconnecting.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Can you open your GlobalProtect client and tell me the gateway you're connected to? I can check the load balancer on my end.

safe_indicators: References specific ticket number you submitted
Asks about technical details, not credentials
voice_content.correct_action: This is a legitimate help desk follow-up on your own ticket. Proceed with the troubleshooting steps. The caller is not asking for passwords or remote access.
